name: repo-switcher
description: Switch between the git repositories below a configurable root folder, like the project dropdown in JetBrains IDEs.

repoSwitcher.root.description: Folder that is searched recursively for git repositories. `~` expands to the home directory.

enumDescriptions: Ask every time whether to open the repository in this window or a new one.
Always open the repository in this window.
Always open the repository in a new window.
repoSwitcher.openIn.description: Where a repository picked from the list is opened. The window button next to an entry always opens a new window.

repoSwitcher.maxDepth.description: How many folder levels below the root are searched.

repoSwitcher.exclude.description: Folder names that are never searched. Hidden folders (starting with a dot) are always skipped.
